# Elite 3D Icon Folder

Drop your high-resolution 3D assets (like those from thiings.co) into this folder to use them directly in the app.

## How to use:
1. Save your 3D icon as a PNG or SVG in this folder.
2. Give it a simple name, e.g., `diamond.png` or `travel.svg`.
3. In the Category Editor, set the icon identifier to `elite:diamond` or `elite:travel`.

The app will automatically prioritize these local files over cloud icons.

*Note: For the best look, use transparent PNGs with a resolution of at least 256x256.*
